name: decentralized-evoting
description: Decentralized E-Voting System with Identity Verification

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd contracts && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.deploy:local: cd contracts && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network localhost
scripts.deploy:ganache: cd contracts && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network ganache
scripts.dev: echo 'Run in separate terminals: npm run node | npm run deploy:local | npm run backend | npm run frontend'
